about: The secreta of the formulary “Saint Matthew, Apostle and Evangelist” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the prayers of the blessed Apostle and Evangelist, Matthew, recommend to You the offering made by Your Church, which is taught by his glorious preaching. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
